correctness.rationale: For any distinct six-point branch set, Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus17. Tame character projectors identify 15 elliptic four-branch quotients and one genus-two six-branch quotient through a 2-primary isogeny. Harmonic fourth completion is unique in characteristic3, yielding at most 3 harmonic 4-subsets. Normalizing one to infinity,0,1,-1 makes genus-two Cartier determinant -(u-v)^2 nonzero, so h>0 forces genus-two ordinary. The 3-rank/a-number and Newton claims follow by additivity of the p-divisible group; exact q=9,27 field examples witness each of six profiles. Reproducible pure-Python verifier passed independently of the general proof. The genus-two rank-zero criterion MM^(3)=0 and matrix convention were cross-checked in Howe (2006) Section 2, including the actual page image.
